run_import_from_tsv: run the import_from_tsv CLI to convert TSV edge list files into TorchBigGraph format using a config file
run_tsv_conversion_with_columns: run the import_from_tsv tool with --lhs-col and --rhs-col to specify source and target entity columns
run_tsv_conversion_with_weights: run the import_from_tsv tool with --weight-col to include edge weights from a TSV file
run_tsv_conversion_with_min_counts: run the import_from_tsv tool with --entity-min-count and --relation-type-min-count to filter sparse entities and relations
run_tsv_conversion_with_config_params: run the import_from_tsv tool with -p flags to override config parameters at the command line
